items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Ken Burns covered that but he didn't go into depth.

ctx.x: didn't have a spotlighted act coming in. I knew I could get a slot. These were all famous musicians there were in the shows. I thought that they should go back as they became famous. This was like, Benny Carter.
Ken Burns covered that but he didn't go into depth. He left out some of the most important things that happened there.
Right. Were you consulted on that at all?
